c: PINCY • DIG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG Legal Opinion No. 58 s. 2011 SEP 14 2011 SIMEON E. GARCIA, JR. Secretary General Pwersa ng Masang Pilipino 409 Shaw Blvd., Mandaluyong City Dear Sir: This pertains to your letter addressed to the Governor of Aklan, a copy of which we received, assailing the propriety of the appointment of Mr. Arturo Gregorio as member of the Sangguniang Bayan [SBI of Altavas replacing the deceased Donald Dalida, and requesting that the appointment of the successor be likewise held in abeyance. Also, consolidated herein are the queries of Hon. Joly A. Solita, Municipal Vice-Mayor, and Hon. Denny D. Refol, Municipal Mayor of Altavas, Aklan, essentially questioning the nomination and subsequent appointment of Mr. Robert M. Gregorio, Jr. as SB Member. Based on the information and documents before us, Sangguniang Bayan Member Donald Dalida, who belongs to your political party, passed away last 25 June 201 1 . With this, your party's provincial chairman nominated Mr. Gregorio as SB Member Dalida's replacement on 26 July 201 1 . Mr. Gregorio was appointed by the Governor on 27 July 2011. Thereafter, your party's municipal chairman sent you a letter protesting the nomination and appointment of Mr. Gregorio stating that the same was done without prior consultation, and that the party's municipal level's nominee is Mr. Ric D'Cor M. Dalida, the son of the deceased SB Member Donald Dalida. Thus, you sent a letter dated 01 August 201 1 to the Governor questioning the appointment of Mr. Gregorio and at the same time requesting that the former's decision on the replacement of deceased SB Member Dalida be held in abeyance, pending investigation by your political party on the matter. The said letter is now the subject of this inquiry. In reply thereto, we regret to inform you that this Department is constrained not to render an opinion on the issue at hand since the appointment made by the Governor is already a duly accomplished act which now enjoys the presumption of regularity and validity. It is a basic rule under Section 3, Rule 131, Rules of Court that once an official duty has been regularly performed, it enjoys the presumption of regularity and validity. Hence, this Department, not being a trier of facts and in adherence to the presumption in law, could only presume the validity of the nomination and appointment of Mr.

Gregorio. This presumption may be overturned only by an order of the court through proper judicial action. Moreover, in a later date, we received a document from the RTC of Kalibo, Aklan pertaining to a civil case entitled: "Ric D' Cor M. Dalida vs. Arturo Gregorio, for QUO Warrantor Prohibition, Preliminary Injunction with prayer for the issuance of Temporary Restraining Order (TRO), which was already filed and is now pending before Branch 2 of the RTC of Kalibo, Aklan. The main issue in said case is the legality of Mr. Gregorio's nomination and subsequent appointment as SB Member of Altavas, Aklan. In this regard, please be advised that we are constrained to refrain from taking action on the matter in view of the basic Constitutional principle of separation of branch and powers. The controversy is already within the domain of the judicial branch of the government. Such being the case, this Department, which is under the executive branch, is not at good liberty to act on the matter as we might be accused of violating the sub-judice rule, which is considered as a contumacious act against the court. We hope that we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very y OUß, ATTY. JESUS .D Dire o Ill cc: Hon. Denny D. Refol Municipal Mayor Altavas, Aklan Hon. Joly A. Solita Municipal Vice Mayor Altavas, Aklan
